scope: manual source-bound selections from 15 externally generated PDFs
common_causes: TextWriter can emit the same glyph IDs with a different CID /W advance; the current backend therefore reuses original code/resource bytes.
A subset font name does not prove coverage for a new Unicode character; missing code maps are rejected.
A clip on the page is not itself a rejection; only an unprovable clip/state at the selected paint event is rejected.
MuPDF full-save resource serialization caused external renderer differences in no-edit controls; pypdf full clone preserves the tested resource values and encryption.
Observed content width remains distinct from inferred or explicitly supplied available width.
